objects.name: Analytic 2228
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol file-transfer service such as Distributed Network Protocol 3 (DNP3) File Transfer Object or Internet Electrotechnical Commision (IEC) 61850 file service being used to place files on a field device from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, outside a scheduled maintenance window, where the transfer source is a device not previously enrolled. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
